title: Quantitative bounds on integrality for post-critically finite maps
summary: Let $K$ be a number field with algebraic closure $\overline{K}$ and let $S$ be a finite set of places of $K$ that contain all the archimedean places. For an integer $d \ge 2$, consider the unicritical polynomial family $f_{d,c}(z) = z^d + c$. Recently, Benedetto and Ih studied the distribution of post-critically finite parameters $c$ that are $S$-integral relative to a fixed point $α\in \overline{K}$ such that $f_{d, α}$ is not post-critically finite.
